about: What's new on the check page, newest first. One plain line per change a parent or teacher would notice, each taken from the changelog fragments it names (changelog.d/<topic>.md, or CHANGELOG.md once released). build_bundle.py --stamp writes the newest ten into analyser.html; tests/whats-new.test.mjs holds the rules.

items.text: The report starts with strengths and uses words, not score numbers.
A one-screen report for pupils, each comment beside their own writing.
If our server restarts during a check, the page waits and offers your photo again.
Neat writing is no longer pulled down by margins or line lengths.
Lines that are hard to read get a faster second look, so long pages finish sooner.
Photos taken sideways or upside down are turned the right way up.
Letter size is measured correctly on pages whose lines slope.
A page of neat handwriting is no longer mistaken for a printed form.
Joined-up writing is measured along whole lines, not in broken pieces.
Maths and science pages get a clear note asking for four lines of English.
